machine: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz, 4 threads, 15 GB RAM, linux

measures.name: Barcode lookup
measures.what: `lookup_code` for a random one of the barcodes (normalise, look up, load the variant)

measures.name: Add item to visible cart
measures.what: a scan through `CartService::scan` on a cart of 1 to 20 lines, returning the priced cart

measures.name: Product search
measures.what: `search` for 20 results, cycling through typical queries

measures.name: Cash-sale local commit
measures.what: `complete_sale` for 3 lines paid in exact cash (one durable transaction, `synchronous=FULL`)

measures.name: 30-day sales report
measures.what: `sales_summary` for the last 30 days (figures per day and totals)

measures.name: Sales list page
measures.what: `SalesService::list`, 50 rows: newest, a date range, a tender, a receipt number

measures.name: Cold launch (backend)
measures.what: open the database (migration check, pragmas) and load the sign-in screen's staff list; the WebView's own start is not included
